g.text: BOWLBY (attachment!): secure base (mum near → child explores!) · separation protest
(protest → despair → DETACHMENT — the quiet "good" child is the WORST sign!) · patterns:
secure/avoidant/resistant. Hospital rule: rooming-in + familiar objects + honest returns
("mum comes after lunch" — and MEANS it!).
PIAGET (thinking stages — exam!): sensorimotor (0-2: peek-a-boo, object permanence —
"mum exists when unseen"!) · pre-operational (2-7: magical, egocentric — "my anger caused
the injection!" — teddy demos!) · concrete (7-11: rules, order, fairness — "why does HE
get more?!" — explain!) · formal (11+: abstract, hypotheticals — reason WITH them!).
HOSPITALISATION TRAUMA: separation + strange faces + pain + loss of control. Prevent:
parents present + play + honest prep ("small ouch, then done") + choices + routine kept.
Regression NORMAL (thumb-sucking returns!) — comfort, never scold.
PLAY = THERAPY: syringe-painting, doll-operations, doctor-kits — mastery through play.
Therapeutic play BEFORE procedures cuts fear + restraint + trauma (COM M5!).
SAFEGUARDING: attachment flags (frozen watchfulness? indiscriminate affection? flinching?)
+ injury-story mismatch + repeat visits → REPORT per policy (PRO-I!). Document exactly.
TEEN BRIDGE: formal thought + identity storm (Erikson, next!) — reason + respect + privacy
(COM M5!). Literal + abstract mixed — check understanding, never assume.
MANTRA: "secure base, honest returns, play first, regress kindly."
